macos.notes: macOS 26.5.2 arm64 proved WebKit child creation, 2x bounds, zero-size convergence, hide/show session reuse, renderer-unmount independence, focus request, close, replacement, host destruction, download denial, navigation denial, and capability isolation. Child visibility and focus readback are unavailable. The one-monitor host could not supply a native scale transition, so that claim remains unmet and unsimulated.

windows.notes: The selected Tauri API is compiled only on the local macOS host. No Windows packaged host was available; creation-handler deadlock behavior and WebView2 bounds, focus, visibility, and teardown remain unproved.

linux.notes: The selected Tauri API is compiled only on the local macOS host. No Linux packaged host was available; WebKitGTK bounds, focus, visibility, and teardown remain unproved. The macOS data-store identifier is rejected by this adapter on Linux.
